title: March 7 Speech
subtitle: A mass political address that reframed the struggle.
summary: On 7 March 1971, Sheikh Mujibur Rahman delivered a landmark speech that politically unified resistance, coordinated civil non-cooperation, and prepared mass society for a decisive confrontation.
heroTagline: A mass political address that reframed the struggle.
whyItMatters: The speech functioned as an operational political framework between electoral mandate and armed conflict.
